name: Heroku Platform MCP Server
summary: Heroku's official MCP server: lets agents create, deploy, scale and inspect apps, run Postgres operations, manage add-ons and read logs on the Heroku Platform.
description: Built on the Heroku CLI (v10.8.1 or later required). The recommended way to start it is `heroku mcp:start`, which reuses your existing CLI login so you do not need to expose `HEROKU_API_KEY`; it can also run via `npx -y @heroku/mcp-server` with an API key. Works on the Common Runtime, Cedar Private and Shield Spaces, and Fir Private Spaces. Heroku describes it as in early development, so tools may change.

agent_access.notes: Local stdio server. `heroku mcp:start` uses the Heroku CLI's login; otherwise set HEROKU_API_KEY.
